description: When used, it activates the Ability of an ally Pok mon.

name: Item Urge
description: When used, it causes an ally Pok mon to use its held item.

name: Item Drop
description: When used, it causes an ally Pok mon to drop a held item.

name: Blue Flute
description: A blue flute made from blown glass. Its melody awakens a single Pok mon from sleep.

name: Yellow Flute
description: A yellow flute made from blown glass. Its melody snaps a single Pok mon out of confusion.

name: Red Flute
description: A red flute made from blown glass. Its melody snaps a single Pok mon out of infatuation.

name: Pok  Doll
description: A doll that attracts Pok mon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pok mon.

name: Fluffy Tail
description: An item that attracts Pok mon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pok mon.

name: Pok  Toy
description: An item that attracts Pok mon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pok mon.

name: Bicycle
description: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.

name: Old Rod
description: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pok mon.

name: Good Rod
description: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pok mon.

name: Super Rod
description: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pok mon.

name: Itemfinder
description: A device used for finding items. If there is a hidden item nearby when it is used, it emits a signal.

name: Dowsing MCHN
description: It checks for unseen items in the area and makes noise and lights when it finds something.

name: Pok  Radar
description: A tool that can search out Pok mon that are hiding in grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

name: Town Map
description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

name: Pok  Flute
description: A flute that is said to instantly awaken any Pok mon. It has a lovely tone.

name: Coin Case
description: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 50,000 coins.

name: Soot Sack
description: A sack used to gather and hold volcanic ash.

name: Silph Scope
description: A scope that makes unseeable Pok mon visible. It is made by Silph Co.

name: Devon Scope
description: A device by Devon that signals any unseeable Pok mon.

name: Squirtbottle
description: A bottle used for watering plants.

name: Sprayduck
description: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.

name: Wailmer Pail
description: A tool used for watering Berries and plants.

name: Gracidea
description: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.

name: Aurora Ticket
description: A ticket required to board the ship to Doxy Island. It glows beautifully.

name: Old Sea Map
description: A faded sea chart that shows the way to a certain island.

name: DNA Splicers
description: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pok mon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.

name: Reveal Glass
description: A glass that reveals the truth. It is a mysterious glass that returns a Pok mon back to its original shape.

name: Oval Charm
description: An oval charm said to increase the chance of Eggs being found at the Day Care.

name: Shiny Charm
description: A shiny charm said to increase the chance of finding a Shiny Pok mon.

name: Xtransceiver
description: A high-tech transceiver with a camera function. It allows up to four-way calls.
